coverage.notes: WKU reports 18 undergraduate programmes and largely English-medium Kean-derived professional curricula. This intentionally selective catalogue pack studies one representative first-entry bachelor from each of the four undergraduate-delivering colleges and separately documents the education and Chinese-curricula colleges. Current college catalogues do not prove every listed degree is open to foreign nationals for Fall 2027. The university separately requires 22 Chinese-language/China-studies credits of international undergraduates under its published 2025 curriculum. The official admissions subdomain could not be directly opened; Fall 2027 admission, cost and scholarship details are preserved from indexed full-text official pages and explicitly marked source-access-limited for revalidation.

institution.summary: China-US university in Wenzhou, Zhejiang, conferring bachelor degrees from Wenzhou-Kean University and Kean University.

programmes.name: Global Business (B.S.)
programmes.language: English-medium major courses; required Chinese-language and China-studies curriculum
programmes.about: A Bachelor of Science covering international markets, cross-cultural management and global business strategy, with a practical client-facing project.
programmes.overview: Students investigate foreign-exchange management, international capital markets, treasury operations and emerging markets. The course also examines how culture, management values and international relationships shape business strategy. A Global Business Practicum brings these themes together in team-based work on a client problem; the university describes collaboration across cultures and the possibility of work with an overseas host. The programme provides preparation for roles in internationally active businesses and entrepreneurial organisations.

programmes.name: B.S. Computer Science
programmes.language: English-medium major courses; required Chinese-language and China-studies curriculum
programmes.about: An English-medium computing degree combining programming, algorithms and systems with applied projects, research opportunities and internships.
programmes.overview: Core modules include data structures, algorithm analysis, computer architecture, networking, operating systems and object-oriented systems design. Students also encounter software engineering, databases, cybersecurity and artificial intelligence in the wider curriculum. The college emphasises small classes, research opportunities and industry internship experience alongside practical software and technology problems. The degree is intended to support entry into computing professions or further postgraduate study.

programmes.name: Psychology B.A.
programmes.language: English-medium major courses; required Chinese-language and China-studies curriculum
programmes.about: A Bachelor of Arts examining mind and behaviour through developmental, experimental and applied psychology, with research methods and placement opportunities.
programmes.overview: The programme develops understanding of human behaviour, personality, perception and development across the lifespan. Required study includes psychological statistics, tests and measurement, experimental psychology and contemporary issues in the discipline. Students practise research, ethical reasoning and professional communication, and the college describes field-placement opportunities at a campus counselling centre and a psychiatric hospital. The degree establishes a foundation for further psychology study and work where behavioural knowledge and research skills are useful.

programmes.name: Architectural Studies
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) in Architectural Studies
programmes.language: English-medium major courses; required Chinese-language and China-studies curriculum
programmes.about: A studio-based Bachelor of Arts exploring architectural design, history, building systems and the social and environmental dimensions of the built environment.
programmes.overview: Students combine architectural history and theory with structural systems, urban and landscape planning, ecology and building regulations. Design studios run each semester, using drawing, digital representation, physical model-making and faculty-guided projects. The school stresses architecture as a public and ecological practice, with collaboration and presentation integral to studio learning. Graduates may pursue architecture-related design work or further professional study; the separate Master of Architecture, not this B.A., is identified as NAAB-accredited.

faculties.name: College of Business and Public Management
faculties.guidance: Undergraduate business degrees include Accounting, Finance, Economics, Global Business, Marketing and Management options. Apply as an international first-year undergraduate via the university-wide admissions route; programme-specific subject thresholds were not confirmed.

faculties.name: College of Science, Mathematics and Technology
faculties.guidance: The undergraduate catalogue lists Computer Science, Biology, Chemistry, Environmental Science and Mathematical Sciences. International first-year application guidance is provided centrally; course-by-course IB prerequisites are not published on the inspected programme pages.

faculties.name: College of Liberal Arts
faculties.guidance: The undergraduate offerings include Psychology, Communication and English. International applicants use the university-wide freshman route, with no verified separate IB-score requirements for the listed degrees.

faculties.name: Michael Graves College of Architecture and Design
faculties.guidance: Undergraduate majors include Architectural Studies, Graphic Design, Industrial Design and Interior Design. Portfolio review applies to architecture/design applications; the 2027 architecture checklist names five drawings, with contradictory submission channels in official versions.

faculties.guidance: The college site lists education M.A. and Ed.D. programmes only; no first-year bachelor in Education was found in its official programme menu. Graduate-only options are out of scope.

faculties.guidance: Delivers shared Chinese-language and China-studies courses, not a separately listed first-entry bachelor. The published 2025 curriculum requires 22 Chinese-curriculum credits for international undergraduates admitted from 2022 onward.

gaps.reason: An explicit 2027 minimum full IB Diploma total, HL total/grades, core-point treatment, competitiveness range and conditional-offer thresholds were not found. IB 30 and 32 in scholarship documentation are not admissions minima.

No explicit admissions policy established whether standalone IB DP Course Results (without the full Diploma), in conjunction with national certificates or bridging, meet eligibility. Optional IB score reporting cannot resolve qualification recognition.
The 2027 guides publish overall English test minima and waivers but no explicitly identified per-component minimum or section-score policy for TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo.

Beyond the 15 June 2027 closing date, verified dates for opening, predicted/final-IB reporting, portfolio submission, admission decisions, acceptance/deposit, start of teaching and accommodation are not specified in inspected official materials. Do not reuse other routes’ 2027 dates.

No admissions source could be independently opened to verify a definitive Fall 2027 programme-by-programme international first-year intake matrix; the 18-degree institutional figure and college catalogues are current general information, not a verified 2027 complete intake list.

The detailed Fall 2027 English admissions pages and Chinese charter were recovered as full-text official search-index results, but direct URL opening failed (cache misses). Admissions rules requiring legally consequential validation should be reopened and checked against WKU originals.
The university-wide Zhejiang Provincial Government Scholarship page is undated. Availability, funding pool and deadlines for 2027 foreign undergraduates could not be verified.

gaps.reason: The architecture portfolio has an officially documented five-task brief, but official Fall 2027 checklist versions contradict each other about sending it by email versus uploading to the application portal.

conflicts.explanation: Two official Fall 2027 WKU-hosted versions of the application-materials checklist give different submission channels for architecture portfolios: email versus application portal. Both agree that the architecture portfolio comprises five works.
conflicts.next_step: Check the current live architecture-specific application screen and obtain authoritative instructions from WKU international admissions before submitting; do not assume either channel is final.
